header.title: Gross Domestic Product (GDP) by economic activity at current prices
tablenote: In Hong Kong, the first released figures on GDP by economic activity in respect of a period are called "preliminary figures".  When more data become available, the figures will be revised.  All those figures published subsequently, after the preliminary figures, are called "revised figures".  These "revised figures" are still subject to further regular revision later on when more data are incorporated.  This routine revision is in accordance with the international practice to compile and release GDP figures at the earliest possible time by using only partial data.  In general, the figures are finalised when finalised data from all regular sources are incorporated.     The above statistics are compiled based on the Hong Kong Standard Industrial Classification (HSIC) Version 2.0.  Users may also download past statistics based on HSIC Version 1.1 for reference.

Refers to nominal GDP at basic prices.  GDP by economic activity at current prices is presented as the sum of value added of respective economic activities at basic price plus taxes on products plus statistical discrepancy, which is equal to GDP by expenditure component.  For data series of taxes on products and statistical discrepancy, please refer to Table 310-34102.
header.source: National Income Section (2)1, Census and Statistics Department (Enquiry telephone no. : 3863 2743  Enquiry e-mail : gdp-p@censtatd.gov.hk)
